written: BEFORE any masked per-game delta or masked p-value was computed or displayed
what_this_is: Q2 is a RE-ANALYSIS of a PRE-REGISTERED primary under a corrected instrument. It is not a new hypothesis and it is not a second bite: the hypothesis, the metric, the clustering, the test and the alpha are all fixed by results/arc_object_perception_ab_change_fidelity_20260801/preregistration.json and are NOT re-chosen here. The only thing that changes is whether the HUD band is inside the graded comparison.

test_fixed_in_advance_by_the_original_pr.clustering: GAME, not attempt -- the 3 replicates within a game are averaged into ONE per-game mean before pairing, so 20 games is 20 independent units, not 60
test_fixed_in_advance_by_the_original_pr.test: exact two-sided paired sign test over games, ties dropped
test_fixed_in_advance_by_the_original_pr.interval: percentile bootstrap over games, 20000 resamples, alpha 0.05

min_reachable_two_sided_p_STATED_BEFORE_.why_this_is_stated_first: an exact sign test on a small number of games has a hard floor, and quoting a p without it lets a reader mistake 'the smallest value this test can produce' for 'strong evidence'. Masking can only REDUCE the number of discordant games (it collapses per-game means toward each other whenever it deletes the cells that differed), so the masked floor can only be HIGHER than the unmasked one -- i.e. the masked test is weaker by construction, before any data is seen.
min_reachable_two_sided_p_STATED_BEFORE_.consequence_if_masking_creates_ties: every game whose masked delta is exactly 0.0 is DROPPED as a tie, which raises the floor. A masked p that is larger than the unmasked p is therefore NOT by itself evidence the effect went away; the number of discordant pairs has to be read next to it.

what_would_count_as_the_effect_SURVIVING: same sign (positive mean delta), p < 0.05, and a bootstrap CI excluding 0 -- the same bar the unmasked analysis had to clear. Anything weaker is reported as weakened or unestablished, not as a null.
what_would_count_as_the_effect_DYING: the direction flips, or p >= 0.05 with a CI spanning 0. In that case the honest reading is that the unmasked effect was at least partly HUD bookkeeping, which is exactly what this re-score exists to find out.

unmasked_values_already_known_at_the_tim.why_disclosed: these are the numbers the re-analysis is being compared against and they were published before this pass ran. Pretending they were unknown would be a false blind.

no_multiplicity_laundering: The masked arms are NOT six independent chances at a significant primary. ONE arm carries the headline (default mask, guard verdict computed on the whole window); the others are a sensitivity on the guard's corpus, an arm that folds in bands the capture artifact WITHHELD, and a diagnostic that bypasses the guard entirely. Each is labelled as such and reported whatever it says, including when it disagrees with the headline arm.
